title: After a restart, a recovered mailbox-wake prompt in an idle, unpaused, control-OFF session is never auto-dispatched
outcome: After a restart, a recovered mailbox-wake prompt in an idle, unpaused, control-OFF session is never auto-dispatched
acceptance: The guard that keeps message-1895317 (a recovered mailbox wake) queued in idle, unpaused session-6219 under control OFF is identified from source with a citation, and classified as an intended safety hold or a defect

If it is a defect, it is fixed so that an eligible queued mailbox wake in an idle, unpaused OFF session dispatches once, with a regression test; if it is intended, the UI shows it as held with its reason instead of 'Agent is working'
